agents.name: Auto-Remediation
agents.summary: AI agent that fixes findings from a scan, validates the fix branch (build + re-scan), and opens one pull request with per-issue commits. Phase 1 keeps partial fixes and always opens the PR with a status summary.
agents.description: AI agent that fixes findings from a scan, validates the fix branch (build + re-scan), and opens one pull request with per-issue commits. Phase 1 keeps partial fixes and always opens the PR with a status summary.

configuration.label: LLM Connector
configuration.note: Select the large language model connector used to generate fixes. Sub-agents require an Anthropic (Claude) backend today.

configuration.label: SCM Connector (Github, Gitlab, Bitbucket, AzureRepo, Git)
configuration.note: Select the source control connector for the repository being remediated. It both clones the codebase into the stage and pushes the fix branch to open the pull request, so its credential must allow pushes and pull request creation. For GitHub, use HTTP authentication with a personal access token that holds the classic repo scope; for Harness Code, use a Git connector with a personal access token. Stamped from the AI Workflow configuration and required because this agent runs outside the project where the repository lives.

configuration.label: MCP Connectors (Mcp)
configuration.note: Select the Model Context Protocol connectors the agent mounts for Harness pipeline execution, failure diagnosis, and finding reads.

prerequisites: SCM Connector (Github, Gitlab, Bitbucket, AzureRepo, Git)
